ops.title: rapid-mlx:8400 downed 2026-07-18 — adopt ManagedServer.idle for long-lived serve consumers
ops.body: The always-on rapid-mlx:8400 (unsloth/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-UD-MLX-4bit, ~20GB) had sat resident since Jul 14 with the operator idle; it was stopped via 'athome serve down rapid-mlx' on 2026-07-18. This is safe by construction: athome.llm.local() and every consumer path call ManagedServer(recipe).ensure() per use, which re-adopts or respawns on demand (cold start ~1-2 min for the 35B). Recommendation for long-lived operator processes: as of v0.9.1, wire the server through ManagedServer('rapid-mlx').idle(ttl_s=...) (athome/idle.py IdleResource) and run its reaper alongside the process, instead of 'serve up --persistent' — batch jobs need nothing (their servers die with the run or stay adoptable); only a resident process that keeps a server warm should hold the IdleResource. cc-steer's watch daemon uses the same primitive in-process as of cc-steer 0.16.0.
